title: This Banknote Was Worth $30 The Day It Was Printed
description:
A real, genuine currency note worth one hundred trillion dollars was worth about $30 the day it launched. Here's the real story behind it.

#shorts #financefacts #didyouknow

scenes.text: This banknote was worth about thirty dollars on the very first day it was ever printed.
It's a real, genuine currency note -- for one hundred trillion dollars.
It was issued by Zimbabwe in January of 2009, during a currency collapse so severe that prices were doubling roughly every twenty four hours.
At its peak, the country's annual inflation rate was estimated at 89.7 sextillion percent -- a number with 21 zeros after it.
The note was pulled from circulation just three months after release, when the country abandoned its own currency completely.
Because it lost almost all its value within days, most of these notes were never actually spent -- which is exactly why so many still exist today in perfect, uncirculated condition.
Would you keep a genuine hundred trillion dollar note as a souvenir, even knowing it's worthless?
